# Jakob Christensen

> Tools, toys and tinkering: free agent skills for Claude Code and other AI agents, teaching tools for visual effects, and a game in the making.

## Agent skills

- [/cheap-agents](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/cheap-agents/): Decides if a helper agent is worth it, and which model is good enough
- [/lanes](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/lanes/): Keeps agent sessions from overwriting each other's work in one repo
- [/fresh](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/fresh/): Spots when a session gets too long and hands the work to a fresh one
- [/now-and-then](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/now-and-then/): Remembers decisions and open points, so every session knows them
- [/am-i-done](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/am-i-done/): Checks whether the whole task is finished before you close the chat
- [/touch-grass](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/touch-grass/): Works through your plan alone while you are away, then reports back
- [/workaround](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/workaround/): Finds another route when the direct one is blocked
- [/reroll](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/reroll/): Asks again in a new chat that never saw the first answer
- [/unrobot](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/unrobot/): Makes a text read as if a person wrote it
- [/sweep](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/sweep/): Frees disk space on Windows drives, deletes only what you approve
- [/strays](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/strays/): Finds commits you never pushed, and pushes them after your OK
- [/tidy-sessions](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/tidy-sessions/): Archives finished sessions in Claude Code Desktop, keeps the rest
- [/tidy-worktrees](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/tidy-worktrees/): Removes worktrees and branches that have landed, keeps the rest
- [/case-closed](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/case-closed/): Puts a ✓ check mark on finished sessions in Claude Code Desktop
- [/attic](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/attic/): Archives sessions that have a ✓ check mark in Claude Code Desktop
- [/fingerprints](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/fingerprints/): Checks a folder for names, paths and keys before you share it
- [/nothing-lost](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/nothing-lost/): Backs up before a big rewrite, then checks that no line got lost
- [/lie-detector](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/lie-detector/): Makes your agent measure claims like faster, smaller or unused
- [/measure-ui](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/measure-ui/): Checks a web page with measured numbers instead of by eye
- [/media-review](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/media-review/): Checks generated images, audio and video against your brief
- [/blindfold](https://jakobchristensen.com/skills/blindfold/): Blind-tests whether a changed prompt really is better
